prompt:
The graph below shows the percentage of adults in one region who regularly took part in three forms of exercise between 2005 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Adults taking part in three forms of exercise, 2005-2025
visual.alt: A line chart showing how the percentage of adults in one region taking part in swimming, running and gym activities changed between 2005 and 2025.

key_points: The ranking completely reverses: in 2005 swimming was the most common (22%) and running the least (9%), while in 2025 swimming is the lowest (14%), with running and the gym higher
Swimming declines throughout (from 22% to 12%) and only recovers slightly in the final five years (14%)
Running rises steadily until 2020, peaking at 26%, then falls back slightly
Gym and fitness classes rise until 2015, dip in 2020, then climb to 28% in 2025, the highest figure of the whole period — ending up in first place
2020 is a turning point for all three series: running peaks while swimming and the gym both bottom out
There are crossovers: both running and the gym overtake swimming between 2010 and 2015; running rises above the gym between 2015 and 2020, then drops back below it in 2025
common_mistakes: Treating the percentage as a number of people ('22 adults went swimming')
Reading the three series year by year without stating that the ranking reverses
Skipping the 2020 turning point or inventing a reason for it ('pools were closed')
Assuming the series must add up to 100% — a person can do more than one activity
